scope: Pre-calibration comparison of a controlled factorial calibration cohort; no independent/global VoiceOver accuracy claim. plan.scope: Controlled calibration: native/custom checkbox × description absent/present × Space/VO+Space, with both checked and unchecked transitions and first/return focus entries. plan.inputEquivalence: Retain every planned row. plan.mainPolicy: Existing normalized Main Speech plus case/punctuation-preserving whitespace-only exact diagnostic. Help prefix classification requires actual observed AXHelp, never predicted help.
plan.fullPolicy: Literal main/hint candidate equality; candidate is not a queue scheduler. Keep missing/repeated hints distinct from main wording and preserve raw receipts.
